operator_id.description:
OperatorID is the hashed ID of the operator (parking attendant) recording the entry
If not provided, it will be extracted from JWT context

plate_number.description: PlateNumber is the vehicle's license plate number

rfid_uid.description: RfidUID is the RFID tag UID for automatic vehicle identification (required)

vehicle_type_id.description: VehicleTypeID is the hashed ID of the vehicle type (e.g., "motorcycle", "car", "truck")

zone_id.description: ZoneID is the hashed ID of the parking zone where the vehicle is entering

payment_method.description: PaymentMethod is the method used for payment (manual or qris)

rfid_uid.description: RfidUID is the RFID tag UID for identifying the vehicle
